messages:
Aisha: Ok team — starting internal intake for Northbridge pilot. Customer goal: integrate Redwood reranker into search relevance for web app by EOM. Need: stakeholder roster, success metrics, enablement timeline, and a clear first 14-day plan. Planning to propose a 45m launch sync on Tue 9 AM PT. Thoughts?
Liam: +1 on Tue. I'll own infra runbook and demo notebook. I can bring quantization notes.
Vera: I'll handle enablement materials and the initial eval prompt set. ETA: draft by Fri. Who's owning permissions for their SSO?
Ravi: I can coordinate SSO and workspace access. I'll ping their IT contact (Julian) and capture required roles. Also: renewal touchpoint should be noted — want to surface adoption signals early.
Aisha: Thanks — adding quick success criteria: 1) search NDCG uplift >= 8% on core queries, 2) 95th percentile latency <= 400ms for UI flows, 3) self-serve doc & runbook published, 4) baseline monitoring + alerting for quality regressions. Agree?
Liam: Agree. For monitoring we should wire up token-level cost dashboard and per-route latency. I'll add dashboards.
Vera: For enablement I'll prepare a 30-min "how to iterate prompts" lab + written TL;DR. Also need a list of sample queries from their PM.
Ravi: I'll ask Julian for sample logs and SSO admin emails. ETA: today EOD.
OnboardBot: Reminder: Create shared folder: /redwood/customers/northbridge/onboard — Aisha to invite assignees.
Aisha: Cool. Action items summarized: Liam — infra + dashboards; Vera — evals + enablement lab; Ravi — SSO + sample queries; Aisha — invite + schedule Tue sync. I'll send a calendar invite once I hear back on Tue availability. :thumbsup:
Liam: FYI tagging #eng-sre for infra review after the sync.
Vera: If we need a canary plan, I suggest 3-day canary on lower traffic route.
Aisha: Good call. We'll include canary gating in runbook. Let's reconvene after Fri drafts.
